subject: Request: One-off pilot credit + fixed-term extension for Fleetwise evaluation
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya@fleetwise.ai>
To: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot run and credits — request to extend window

Hi Grace,

Quick note — we're very close to completing the integration with our data ingest, but gave ourselves a smaller-than-expected buffer for model tuning. The integrations team hit an internal delay (vendor cert cycle) and we lost ~10 testing days.

Can Redwood consider: 1) a 30-day one-off extension to our pilot end date (currently 11/02), and 2) an extra $8k of complimentary credits so our SREs can run batch tests without affecting the limited evaluation quota?

This is a strategic evaluation for us — Fleetwise plans to standardize on a single inference provider if the pilot proves out. We're sharing the integration plan and a short usage snapshot (attached). We can sign an addendum (POC addendum) if that helps.

Appreciate any flexibility here. Happy to hop on a quick call.

Thanks,
Maya
Maya Singh
Head of ML Ops | Fleetwise
maya@fleetwise.ai

Attachments: fleetwise-eval-plan.pdf (summary, 2 pages); usage-snapshot-20261001.csv (redacted)

From: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodai.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodai.com>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwoodai.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot run and credits — Fleetwise ask (requesting one-off approval)

Karthik/Jonas — forwarding Fleetwise's ask. TL;DR: 30-day one-off extension + $8k complimentary credits. Customer already integrated most of ingestion, delay from a vendor cert pushed them back ~10 days.

Why I recommend approving (summary):
- Strategic fit: Fleetwise is a midmarket mobility platform with strong potential for multi-region expansion; procurement signals enterprise intent (PO issued after pilot).
- Momentum: Integration is >70% complete; engineers are blocked on vendor-side certs, not on Redwood-side work.
- Economics: $8k credits buys a full run of batch QA at scale; expected to accelerate a paid pilot conversion within 90 days.

Proposed one-off terms (what I'd like to sign off if approved):
- Grant $8,000 in one-time credits, valid for the extended 30-day window only. No rollover.
- Extend pilot end date from 2026-11-02 to 2026-12-02.
- Require an abbreviated addendum (link below) and a PO for the post-pilot contract being discussed; collect updated billing contact.

Attachments: I'm attaching the customer's eval plan and our last 7-day usage snapshot. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/654321

If you want a tighter constraint (lower credits or a shorter extension), suggest 15 days + $4k credits.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodai.com>

Date: 2026-10-05T11:37:00-07:00
Subject: Deal desk ask: Fleetwise one-off credit & extension — approval request (deal FW-2026-1923)

Aditya/Jonas —

Please see the background below and Grace's recommendation. This is a one-time exception request for Fleetwise (FW-2026-1923). Key points:
- Customer: Fleetwise (mobility SaaS), account exec: grace_oconnor.
- Ask: $8k in complimentary credits tied to a 30-day pilot extension.
- Rationale: Integration delay out of customer's control; high conversion likelihood per SE signals; procurement already engaged and expects a PO after pilot.

Commercial implications:
- Standard PLG cap for such pilots is $2k + 14-day extension only. This request exceeds both credit and duration thresholds.
- Upside: If conversion occurs within 90 days, expected ARR > $120k/yr (conservative estimate).

Risk mitigation / recommended guardrails:
1) Credits expire on 2026-12-02 and are non-refundable; usage metrics to be tracked and reported by Grace weekly.
2) Customer signs a short addendum confirming the terms; procurement provides intent PO by pilot-end.
3) Technical check-in (SE) scheduled 7 days after extension starts to confirm progress.

Attached: Fleetwise eval plan + usage snapshot. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/654321 (deal stage: evaluation)

Approval options (please reply with exact terms):
A) Approve $8k credits + 30-day extension (Grace's request).
B) Approve $4k credits + 15-day extension (middle ground).
C) Deny; offer standard $2k + 14-day extension.

Please reply with A/B/C or provide alternate terms.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Deal Desk Analyst
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodai.com

From: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwoodai.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodai.com>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwoodai.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-10-06T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Deal desk ask: Fleetwise one-off credit & extension — approval request (deal FW-2026-1923)

Thanks for the clear write-up Karthik and Grace for the context. I'm comfortable approving a one-time concession with conditions. Replying with option A but with the following conditions:

- Approve $6,000 of complimentary credits (one-time), valid only for the extension period (2026-11-03 through 2026-12-02).
- Approve a 21-day extension (new pilot end date: 2026-11-23).
- Require a signed addendum (term sheet link) before credits are applied and a procurement PO with intent to convert by pilot end.
- Grace to provide a usage checkpoint report at day +7 and day +14 after extension starts; Deal Desk to receive the check-ins.

Reasoning: balances commercial upside with credit exposure. If the customer signs PO and shows healthy usage in the checkpoints, we can consider accelerating purchase discussions.

Karthik — please confirm and I'll have Legal enable the addendum template and Finance hold the credit allocation. Grace — can you communicate these conditions to Maya and get the PO cadence?

Aditya
